summary: NULL pointer dereference in i2c_transfer when adapter is unregistered
description:
When an I2C adapter is hot-unplugged while a transfer is in progress, the kernel crashes with a NULL pointer dereference in i2c_transfer(). The crash occurs because adap->algo->master_xfer is called after the adapter has been freed.

Call trace:
  i2c_transfer+0x5c/0x120
  i2c_smbus_xfer+0x104/0x380
  i2c_smbus_read_byte_data+0x44/0x80

This affects all platforms using the i2c-core subsystem. Reproducible by unbinding the i2c adapter while running i2cdetect.
